title: Researcher forwards an alleged Ransone email, then vanishes

tellings.quote: And and so he forwards me an email, which is allegedly from Valerie, which

plain: An unnamed researcher says a contact forwarded him an email said to be from Valerie Ransone, described on the show as a CIA scientist who contacted an alien council, and that the contact then vanished. He tells Michels this as something that happened to him, and he calls the email only "allegedly" hers. The story matters to him because the email was a rare trace of Ransone, and the man who sent it then disappeared.
